confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are based on web searches of cost-of-living guides and crowd-sourced price pages (Expatistan, whereandwhen.net and blogs). Sources were mixed in age and sample size, and I set the anchors near the middle of the reported ranges, adjusted up for July tourist season. The wine glass is inferred from the local beer price and a dated bottle price, not from a direct restaurant-glass figure. Cocktail is a bounded estimate from the sourced range (EUR 8 to 12). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live booking pages or current listings. The FX observation is the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page quote for 15 October 2026. I could not open the F11.1 daily table to confirm it. The EUR-to-USD conversion used for the food and drink figures is an approximation of about 1.12, derived from the RBA AUD/USD quote and a third-party AUD/EUR quote, not from a directly sourced EUR/USD observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Spanish Mediterranean tourist city. Cost-of-living sources describe Malaga as generally cheaper than Barcelona, Madrid or Seville for food and drink, so restaurant anchors were set below those cities. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a summer tourist market in a similar-sized Andalusian coastal city.
